scope: P14 Arabic hadith/report source-candidate audit. An eligible candidate is not automatically an authoritative edition or an ingested dataset.

candidates.sourceCharacter: secondary structured extraction from sunnah.com; must not become authority by default

structure.transmitter: narrator as source string; structured person/transmitter identity requires separate reviewed evidence

constraints: Do not bundle text_en, matn_en, or English narrator/translation fields until translator/publisher redistribution rights are independently verified.
Preserve matn and isnad as distinct source layers; never infer transmitter biography or historical truth from chain text.
Preserve collection/book/chapter/report hierarchy and exact source reference.
Before P14-007 ingestion, select a bounded collection and verify it against an authenticated/primary edition or stronger source witness; sunnah.com scraping is provenance, not canonical authority.

candidates.reason: Public repository and useful bilingual/annotated structure were discoverable, but an explicit redistribution license for the corpus was not established in this audit.
